moments.text: Infrared targeting display looking down at rippled sea. The tracking box grows and shrinks and a cross marker comes and goes as the sensor slews.
The box settles below centre on a small light spot over the water.
Lock-on: brackets close on the small light spot and a range readout appears (4.4 RNG) as the sea streams diagonally behind it.
The display flips polarity (overlay BLK to WHT): the sea turns lighter grey and the object shows as a dark spot in the brackets.
Polarity flips back (overlay WHT to BLK): the small light spot stays in the brackets while the range readout falls to 3.3 by the end.

notes: Display centre-cropped (474px pillarbox each side cut).
